Entries.Original: All right, gals. As you all know, we're headin' out to liberate the experimental farm.
Drone footage indicates that, just like yesterday, the Cancer is still fortified within the farm, with smaller Cancers patrolling the area.
When we fought it yesterday, we ended up surrounded while struggling with the main Cancer. So this time, we should focus on eliminating the smaller ones.
I will handle it. Consider every last one of them killed.
Also, HQ analyzed yesterday's combat and gave us a writeup on da new Cancer.
Like you saw yesterday, it's all lubed up with slime that blocks attacks. We gotta do somethin' about that.
Kinda looks like the slime regenerates on its own, but not instantly. It needs time.
So on this attempt, we will employ Irene's and Charl's long-range attacks to lure it into protracted battle.
Their ranged fire will whittle down the slime and lure it out of the farm. Once it is exhausted, Carole and Maria will ambush it and finish it off!
This is an emergency, so we gonna hold off on the coordination attack thing. Gotta go with the old reliable this time.
